title: KHR_character_expression_morphtarget KHR_character_expression Extension
description: Classifies selected expression-animation channels as node morph-weight channels.

channels.description: Nonempty array of unique indices classifying node morph-weight channels. Classification does not select or filter channels for base expression evaluation.

items.description: Index of a classified channel in the expression entry's selected animation.
items.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `channels` array of the animation selected by the containing expression entry's `animation` property. The channel MUST target node morph weights through an ordinary core weights target or a valid KHR_animation_pointer node-weights target.
